services.name: Ballooning Events
services.desc: Your flight begins with the purchase of a flight certificate. Once purchased you may schedule your flight at any time throughout the year. Please schedule early to ensure the best availability. Your flight is a private flight, which means only you or your group will be the only ones in the balloon except for the pilot of course. Once you have decided on a date to fly and the weather cooperates, you will meet the pilot, the balloon crew, and the balloon at our meeting location. We meet all passengers in O'Fallon MO at Dirty Dogz Hot Dogs restaurant, 3720 Monticello Plaza Dr. on Hwy K in the strip mall. Meeting times depend on the time of year.
